zh:
“PDF → 抽文本 → 固定长度切分 → 向量库”在真实企业文档上会失败：目录多栏、页眉页脚、复杂表格、流程图、扫描页、盖章签名、跨页引用。结果是阅读顺序错乱、表格行列丢失、标题正文割裂、页眉污染召回、图表信息消失。生产级方案 = 四层处理 + 两条底线。

FIG.5.1

总览：Parse → Reconstruct → Index → Tool ＋ Citation ＋ Evaluation

STEP 1

① Parse 解析

先识别文档 / 页面类型，再选择解析路径
STEP 2

② Reconstruct 结构重建

恢复层级、阅读顺序与定位基因
STEP 3

③ Index 语义切片 + 混合索引

按信息类型进入不同索引路径
STEP 4

④ Tool Chain 受控文档工具

按需翻阅，而不是暴力通读
底线一

Page-level Citations + Claim Verification
关键论断绑定 document · page · section/table · excerpt。

底线二

分层评测闭环
评测要能回答“哪一层失败了”，而不只是“最终答案错了”。

第一层 · Parsing：先分类，再选解析路径

NATIVE原生文本 PDF
直接读取 text span · font · bounding box · page coordinate · reading order candidate。重点：保留位置和版式信息，为结构恢复提供依据。
SCAN扫描件 PDF
本质是图片容器，需 OCR 输出：识别文本 · bbox · confidence · 页旋转 · 语言。低置信区域不能悄悄入库：重新识别 / 换模型 / 标低质量证据 / 人工复核。
MIXED图文混排 PDF
Layout parser + 图/图表抽取 + Vision-language 理解。输出不应只是“这是一张图”，而应形成可检索语义：“Figure 4 shows an approval workflow: request → manager review → finance review → payment release.”
核心原则

Choose the extraction method by document and page type; do not force every PDF through one parser.

第二层 · Structure Reconstruction：恢复文档语义

FIG.5.2

结构树 + 定位基因

 Document
 ├── Chapter
 │    ├── Section
 │    │    ├── Paragraph
 │    │    ├── Table
 │    │    └── Figure
 │    └── Footnote
 └── Appendix

 每个信息点携带“定位基因”：
 document_id · page · section_path
 paragraph_id · table_id · figure_id
 bounding_box
  • 多栏阅读顺序：按页面对象顺序抽取会出现“左栏一段 → 右栏一段”交错，必须恢复列、块与正确阅读顺序，并把标题层级附着到正文。
  • 页眉页脚：跨页重复模式识别后删除正文副本，或保留为专门 metadata，避免反复进入 Embedding。
  • 表格：恢复 row / column / header / merged cell / unit / caption / 跨页续表关系，存为 Markdown / CSV / JSON / DB 行，支持精确查询、范围过滤、数值比较、聚合。
  • 图像：绑定 figure number · caption · 周围段落 · page · section · vision 描述。
必背

Structure reconstruction turns page objects into traceable document semantics.

第三层 · Semantic Chunking 与 Hybrid Index

CHUNK结构感知切片规则
同一标题下连续段落 → 一个或多个语义 chunk · 完整条款尽量保持完整 · 完整表格单独结构化 · 图 + caption + 描述绑定为 figure chunk · 超长章节在子标题/段落边界继续切。
权衡：过小 → 缺上下文、检索碎片化；过大 → 召回不精确、上下文成本高。
Contextual Enrichment
孤立 chunk “Revenue decreased by 12%.” → 补充短上下文（来自第 3 章 Currency Risk，描述 2025 财年汇率影响）。原文与模型生成的上下文必须分开存储，避免把生成摘要误当原始证据。
信息类型索引路径
自然语言段落Dense + BM25
合同条款与术语BM25 + Dense
编号、日期、版本Exact / Keyword fields
结构化表格SQL / 结构化存储 + lexical
章节、页码、权限Metadata filter
跨实体关系Optional graph index
 
 { "document_id": "policy-2026-de", "page": 17,
   "section_path": ["3 Risk Factors", "3.2 Currency Risk"],
   "content_type": "paragraph", "language": "en", "version": "2026",
   "valid_from": "2026-01-01", "access_scope": "finance-eu" }
核心原则

Do not embed everything in the same way. Index according to the information type and the expected query operation.

第四层 · Agent Tool Chain：按需翻阅

FIG.5.3

受控工具执行过程

STEP 1

分析问题需要哪些证据

STEP 2

search_pdf(query, filters)

STEP 3

read_page / read_section

STEP 4

extract_table / analyze_chart

STEP 5

quote_source(chunk_id)

STEP 6

生成答案 → Claim Verification

好处：上下文更小成本更低 · 工具调用可记录可重放 · 表格图表由专门工具处理 · 证据不足时可继续翻页 · 每步可定位失败原因。约束：input schema · permission checks · maximum calls · allowed scope · timeout · logging · idempotency。

必背

The agent decides what evidence it needs; deterministic document tools control how that evidence is retrieved.

底线一 · Page-level Citations 与 Claim Verification

FIG.5.4

引用校验流程

STEP 1

Draft answer

STEP 2

Extract claims

STEP 3

Match each claim to evidence

STEP 4

Check entailment & scope

STEP 5

Remove / qualify / refuse 无支持 claim

例：文档只说 “The policy may be reviewed annually.”，系统不能扩写为 “The policy is updated every year.”。Citation correctness（引用是否真的支持 Claim）＋Citation completeness（所有关键 Claim 是否都有引用）。合同、财报、风控、合规场景，缺页码和原文证据的答案不应视为完成。

底线二 · 分层评测闭环

层指标
ParsingOCR Character / Word Error Rate · OCR confidence coverage · Reading-order accuracy · Page classification accuracy
StructureHeading hierarchy accuracy · Table cell accuracy · Header/footer removal accuracy · Figure-caption association accuracy
RetrievalPage Recall@K · Chunk Recall@K · Table Retrieval Recall · MRR / NDCG · Metadata-filter correctness
Evidence & AnswerEvidence sufficiency accuracy · Citation correctness / completeness · Answer correctness · False refusal rate · Unsafe answer rate
FIG.5.5

错误诊断树：答案错误 → 失败在哪一层？

正确页面没进索引
→ Parsing / ingestion failure
页面存在但没被召回
→ Retrieval failure
召回正确但表格解析错
→ Structure / table failure
证据正确但结论超原文
→ Generation / verification failure
证据不足仍回答
→ Decision-policy failure
必背

A production evaluation should tell us which stage failed, not only that the final answer was wrong.

权限、版本与生命周期

Tenant isolation · Document-level ACL · Page/section 限制 · Version validity · Superseded 文档 · Retention/deletion · Index refresh · Audit trail。权限过滤尽量发生在检索前，返回前再校验一次。版本冲突结合 valid_from/valid_to · supersedes · region · BU · source authority；仍无法确认有效版本 → 明确拒答或升级，而不是随机选一篇相关文档。

90 秒英文答案（见第 11 章 · 可复制）

A production PDF RAG system is more than text extraction followed by embeddings. I would design it as a four-layer document-intelligence pipeline… Every important claim must be supported by a page-level citation.

完整版在 。

诚信映射

不应声称已完整上线生产级 PDF RAG。可说：“My direct experience is stronger in retrieval workflows, case-based reasoning, validation, fallback logic, structured artifacts, and tool-oriented agent systems. I understand how those principles extend to PDF RAG: parsing and structure recovery must be separated from retrieval, evidence must preserve provenance, and the agent should use controlled tools rather than treating the whole document as one prompt.”

2026-09-28 · 验证边界

OCR 字段支持依引擎而异；未知 confidence 不能伪造。Chunk 大小对 Recall 与 Precision 要分别评测。解析质量约束文本索引；重新读取原始页面/图像可以提供补救路径。原有 newsletter 实例全文本次未能取得。

Docling

Grounded Document Agent：从 PDF 检索到可验证证据链 §5.Y

长文档问答的目标不只是找到相似文本，而是让每个回答都能沿着 Evidence Chunk → Page / Section → Source Document 反向追溯。公开项目示例使用 LlamaParse 解析长 PDF，并让本地 Ollama 模型完成检索与回答，同时返回精确页面引用；生产系统应在这个基础上继续补齐证据充分性判断、引用校验与拒答边界。

FIG.5.Y

Grounded Document Agent = provenance-preserving retrieval + support gate + citation verification

解析质量决定检索上限；Grounding 质量取决于答案是否被原始证据真正支持，而不是页面上是否出现了一个 citation 字符串。

1 · PARSE

结构化解析，而不是只抽纯文本

尽量保留 page boundary、heading hierarchy、table、figure、reading order 与可定位的 layout metadata。
2 · INDEX

Chunk 不能切断 provenance

每个 EvidenceChunk 至少携带 document_id、page、section、chunk_id 与 parser provenance；布局敏感任务再保留 bbox / element metadata。
3 · RETRIEVE

检索 Evidence Bundle，而不是孤立相似片段

查询可组合 semantic retrieval、keyword / metadata filter、reranking，并在需要时读取相邻页或同一 section 的连续上下文。
4 · SUPPORT GATE

先判断证据够不够，再决定是否回答

不足时应扩展检索、重写 query、检查相邻 section，或者直接 abstain；不要把“检索到了东西”误当成“足够支持答案”。
5 · ANSWER

只基于当前 Evidence Bundle 生成

回答中的关键 claim 应映射回一个或多个 source span，并携带 page / section citation。
6 · VERIFY

验证 claim ↔ evidence，而不是只验证 citation 存在

Citation Presence 只是第一层；更重要的是 Citation Correctness 与 Claim–Evidence Entailment。失败时修复回答、重新检索或拒答。
GROUNDING CONTRACT

Citation Presence ≠ Citation Correctness。页面号存在，只能证明系统打印了引用；真正的可靠性要求引用页面支持对应 claim，并且用户能够回到原文验证。

PARSING CEILING

Document QA quality ≈ Parsing × Retrieval × Evidence Selection × Generation × Citation Verification。解析阶段把表格、阅读顺序或页边界破坏之后，后面的 embedding 与 LLM 很难恢复原始语义。

EvidenceChunk：把 provenance 当成一等数据

Field为什么需要生产用途
document_id区分来源与版本权限、去重、更新与 lineage
page / section保留人类可验证的位置页面引用、邻页扩展与 section-aware retrieval
chunk_id为证据建立稳定标识缓存、评估、回放与错误分析
bbox / element保留视觉文档的局部位置表格、图像、highlight 与 multimodal verification
parser_provenance知道文本是如何被解析出来的parser regression、版本比较与重建索引
retrieval_score记录为何进入 Evidence Bundlethreshold、reranking、eval 与 failure analysis
AGENTIC BOUNDARY

普通 RAG 可以是一次 retrieve → generate；Agentic Document QA 的价值从“检索变成决策过程”开始：系统根据当前证据决定继续检索、扩大范围、查看相邻页面、重写查询或拒答。这个循环应保持 bounded，并把停止条件、最大检索轮数和权限边界写清楚。

FAIL常见错误：把 citation 当装饰
只检查“有没有 [Page 17]”会放过错误引用。更可靠的评估单位是 claim：每个关键 claim 是否有匹配 evidence，evidence 是否真的蕴含该 claim。
GATE正确边界：证据不足时允许不回答
Grounded system 的目标不是最大化 answer rate，而是最大化 supported answer rate。证据不足时 abstain，是可靠性机制，不是失败。
SOURCE / SCOPE

来源示例：AI Engineering 的 Hands-On: Build a Grounded Document Agent。公开项目说明确认了 long-PDF QA、LlamaParse、Ollama 与精确页面引用。上面的 support gate、claim–evidence verification、bounded re-retrieval 与 abstention 是本手册基于生产 RAG / Agent reliability 原则做的工程化扩展，而不是对原教程逐句复述。 AI Engineering source.

相关章节：证据不足时的选择性回答与拒答见 Chapter 04；bounded agent loop、停止条件与恢复边界见 Chapter 08。 Ch.04 · Ch.08
en:
“PDF → extract text → fixed-length chunking → vector database” fails on real enterprise documents: multi-column tables of contents, headers/footers, complex tables, flowcharts, scanned pages, stamps/signatures, and cross-page references. The result iswrong reading order, lost table rows/columns, broken title–body structure, header/footer contamination in retrieval, and missing chart information. A production-grade solution = four processing layers + two hard requirements。

FIG.5.1

Overview: Parse → Reconstruct → Index → Tool + Citation + Evaluation

STEP 1

① Parse

First identify the document/page type, then choose the parsing path
STEP 2

② Reconstruct Structure

Recover hierarchy, reading order, and positioning metadata
STEP 3

③ Index: Semantic Chunking + Hybrid Index

Route different information types into different indexing paths
STEP 4

④ Tool Chain: Controlled Document Tools

Read on demand instead of brute-force reading everything
Hard Requirement 1

Page-level Citations + Claim Verification
Bind key claims to document · page · section/table · excerpt.

Hard Requirement 2

Layered Evaluation Loop
Evaluation must answer “which layer failed,” not merely “the final answer was wrong.”

Layer 1 · Parsing: Classify First, Then Choose the Parsing Path

NATIVENative-text PDF
Directly extract text span · font · bounding box · page coordinate · reading-order candidates.Focus: preserve positional and layout informationto support structure reconstruction.
SCANScanned PDF
Essentially an image container; OCR should output recognized text · bbox · confidence · page rotation · language. Low-confidence regions must not silently enter the index: re-recognize / switch models / mark as low-quality evidence / send for human review.
MIXEDMixed text-and-image PDF
Use a layout parser + image/chart extraction + vision-language understanding. The output should not merely say “this is an image”; it should produce retrievable semantics:“Figure 4 shows an approval workflow: request → manager review → finance review → payment release.”
Core Principle

Choose the extraction method by document and page type; do not force every PDF through one parser.

Layer 2 · Structure Reconstruction: Recover Document Semantics

FIG.5.2

Structure Tree + Location Metadata

 Document
 ├── Chapter
 │    ├── Section
 │    │    ├── Paragraph
 │    │    ├── Table
 │    │    └── Figure
 │    └── Footnote
 └── Appendix

 Each information unit carries “location metadata”:
 document_id · page · section_path
 paragraph_id · table_id · figure_id
 bounding_box
  • Multi-column Reading Order:Extracting by raw page-object order can interleave “left-column paragraph → right-column paragraph.” Recover columns, blocks, and correct reading order, and attach title hierarchy to body text.
  • Headers and Footers:Detect repeated cross-page patterns and remove their body-text duplicates, or retain them only as dedicated metadata so they do not repeatedly enter embeddings.
  • Tables:Recover row / column / header / merged cell / unit / caption / cross-page continuation relationships. Store as Markdown / CSV / JSON / DB rows to support exact queries, range filters, numerical comparisons, and aggregation.
  • Images:Bind figure number · caption · surrounding paragraphs · page · section · vision description.
Must Remember

Structure reconstruction turns page objects into traceable document semantics.

Layer 3 · Semantic Chunking and Hybrid Index

CHUNKStructure-aware Chunking Rules
Continuous paragraphs under the same heading → one or more semantic chunks · keep complete clauses together when possible · store complete tables separately in structured form · bind image + caption + description as a figure chunk · split very long sections again at subheading/paragraph boundaries.
Trade-off:Too small → missing context and fragmented retrieval; too large → imprecise recall and higher context cost.
Contextual Enrichment
For an isolated chunk “Revenue decreased by 12%.” → add a short context prefix (from Chapter 3 Currency Risk, describing the FX impact in fiscal year 2025).Store source text separately from model-generated contextto avoid treating generated summaries as original evidence.
Information TypeIndexing Path
Natural-language paragraphsDense + BM25
Contract clauses and terminologyBM25 + Dense
Identifiers, dates, versionsExact / Keyword fields
Structured tablesSQL / structured storage + lexical retrieval
Sections, pages, permissionsMetadata filter
Cross-entity relationshipsOptional graph index
 
 { "document_id": "policy-2026-de", "page": 17,
   "section_path": ["3 Risk Factors", "3.2 Currency Risk"],
   "content_type": "paragraph", "language": "en", "version": "2026",
   "valid_from": "2026-01-01", "access_scope": "finance-eu" }
Core Principle

Do not embed everything in the same way. Index according to the information type and the expected query operation.

Layer 4 · Agent Tool Chain: Read on Demand

FIG.5.3

Controlled Tool Execution Flow

STEP 1

Analyze what evidence the question requires

STEP 2

search_pdf(query, filters)

STEP 3

read_page / read_section

STEP 4

extract_table / analyze_chart

STEP 5

quote_source(chunk_id)

STEP 6

Generate Answer → Claim Verification

Benefits:Smaller context and lower cost · tool calls are logged and replayable · tables/charts use specialized tools · when evidence is insufficient, the agent can continue reading · each step exposes the failure point.Constraints:input schema · permission checks · maximum calls · allowed scope · timeout · logging · idempotency。

Must Remember

The agent decides what evidence it needs; deterministic document tools control how that evidence is retrieved.

Hard Requirement 1 · Page-level Citations and Claim Verification

FIG.5.4

Citation Validation Flow

STEP 1

Draft answer

STEP 2

Extract claims

STEP 3

Match each claim to evidence

STEP 4

Check entailment & scope

STEP 5

Remove / qualify / refuse unsupported claims

Example: if the document only says “The policy may be reviewed annually.”, the system must not expand it into “The policy is updated every year.”。Citation correctness(does the citation actually entail the Claim?) +Citation completeness(do all key Claims have citations?). In contracts, financial reports, risk control, and compliance, an answer without page numbers and source evidence should not be considered complete.

Hard Requirement 2 · Layered Evaluation Loop

LayerMetric
ParsingOCR Character / Word Error Rate · OCR confidence coverage · Reading-order accuracy · Page classification accuracy
StructureHeading hierarchy accuracy · Table cell accuracy · Header/footer removal accuracy · Figure-caption association accuracy
RetrievalPage Recall@K · Chunk Recall@K · Table Retrieval Recall · MRR / NDCG · Metadata-filter correctness
Evidence & AnswerEvidence sufficiency accuracy · Citation correctness / completeness · Answer correctness · False refusal rate · Unsafe answer rate
FIG.5.5

Failure Diagnosis Tree: wrong answer → which layer failed?

The correct page never entered the index
→ Parsing / ingestion failure
The page exists but was not retrieved
→ Retrieval failure
The correct evidence was retrieved but the table was parsed incorrectly
→ Structure / table failure
The evidence is correct but the conclusion exceeds the source text
→ Generation / verification failure
The system answered despite insufficient evidence
→ Decision-policy failure
Must Remember

A production evaluation should tell us which stage failed, not only that the final answer was wrong.

Permissions, Versions, and Lifecycle

Tenant isolation · Document-level ACL · Page/section restrictions · Version validity · Superseded documents · Retention/deletion · Index refresh · Audit trail. Permission filtering should happen as early as possible, ideallybefore retrieval, with another validation before returning the result. Resolve version conflicts using valid_from/valid_to · supersedes · region · BU · source authority; if the valid version still cannot be determined → explicitly refuse or escalate instead of randomly choosing a related document.

90-second English Answer (see Chapter 11 · copyable)

A production PDF RAG system is more than text extraction followed by embeddings. I would design it as a four-layer document-intelligence pipeline… Every important claim must be supported by a page-level citation.

Full version in 。

Honest Project Mapping

Do not claim that you have already deployed a complete production-grade PDF RAG system. You can say:“My direct experience is stronger in retrieval workflows, case-based reasoning, validation, fallback logic, structured artifacts, and tool-oriented agent systems. I understand how those principles extend to PDF RAG: parsing and structure recovery must be separated from retrieval, evidence must preserve provenance, and the agent should use controlled tools rather than treating the whole document as one prompt.”

2026-09-28 · Verification boundaries

OCR fields depend on the engine; missing confidence must stay unknown. Evaluate chunk size against recall and precision separately. Parsing constrains a text index; revisiting original pages or images can recover evidence. The original newsletter example was unavailable in this audit.

Docling

Grounded Document Agent: From PDF retrieval to a verifiable evidence chain §5.Y

The goal of long-document QA is not merely to find similar text, but to make every answer traceable through Evidence Chunk → Page / Section → Source Document. The public project example uses LlamaParse to parse long PDFs and local Ollama models for retrieval and answering while returning exact page citations; a production system should extend this with evidence-sufficiency checks, citation validation, and abstention boundaries.

FIG.5.Y

Grounded Document Agent = provenance-preserving retrieval + support gate + citation verification

Parsing quality sets the upper bound for retrieval. Grounding quality depends on whether the answer is actually supported by source evidence, not whether a citation string merely appears beside it.

1 · PARSE

Parse structure, not just plain text

Preserve page boundaries, heading hierarchy, tables, figures, reading order, and locatable layout metadata whenever possible.
2 · INDEX

Chunking must preserve provenance

Each EvidenceChunk should carry at least document_id, page, section, chunk_id, and parser provenance; layout-sensitive tasks should also keep bbox or element metadata.
3 · RETRIEVE

Retrieve an evidence bundle, not isolated similar fragments

A query may combine semantic retrieval, keyword or metadata filters, reranking, and neighboring-page or same-section context when continuity matters.
4 · SUPPORT GATE

Judge evidence sufficiency before deciding to answer

If support is insufficient, expand retrieval, rewrite the query, inspect neighboring sections, or abstain. Do not confuse 'something was retrieved' with 'the answer is supported.'
5 · ANSWER

Generate only from the current evidence bundle

Each material claim should map back to one or more source spans and carry page or section citations.
6 · VERIFY

Verify claim ↔ evidence, not merely citation presence

Citation Presence is only the first layer. More important are Citation Correctness and Claim–Evidence Entailment. On failure, repair the answer, retrieve again, or abstain.
GROUNDING CONTRACT

Citation Presence ≠ Citation Correctness. A page number only proves that the system printed a citation; reliability requires the cited source to support the corresponding claim and to remain inspectable by the user.

PARSING CEILING

Document QA quality ≈ Parsing × Retrieval × Evidence Selection × Generation × Citation Verification. Once parsing destroys table structure, reading order, or page boundaries, stronger embeddings and LLMs usually cannot reconstruct the original semantics reliably.

EvidenceChunk: Treat provenance as first-class data

FieldWhy it mattersProduction use
document_idDistinguishes source and versionPermissions, deduplication, updates, and lineage
page / sectionPreserves a human-verifiable locationPage citations, neighboring-page expansion, and section-aware retrieval
chunk_idCreates a stable evidence identifierCaching, evaluation, replay, and error analysis
bbox / elementPreserves local position in visual documentsTables, figures, highlights, and multimodal verification
parser_provenanceRecords how the text was producedParser regression analysis, version comparison, and index rebuilds
retrieval_scoreRecords why the chunk entered the evidence bundleThresholding, reranking, evals, and failure analysis
AGENTIC BOUNDARY

Ordinary RAG may be a single retrieve → generate pass. Agentic Document QA begins when retrieval becomes a decision process: the system uses current evidence to decide whether to retrieve again, widen scope, inspect neighboring pages, rewrite the query, or abstain. Keep this loop bounded, with explicit stopping conditions, retrieval limits, and permission boundaries.

FAILCommon failure: treating citations as decoration
Checking only whether '[Page 17]' exists will miss incorrect citations. A better evaluation unit is the claim: does every material claim have matching evidence, and does that evidence actually entail the claim?
GATECorrect boundary: allow no-answer when evidence is insufficient
A grounded system should not maximize answer rate; it should maximize supported answer rate. Abstaining when evidence is insufficient is a reliability mechanism, not a failure.
SOURCE / SCOPE

Source example: AI Engineering's Hands-On: Build a Grounded Document Agent. The public project description confirms long-PDF QA, LlamaParse, Ollama, and exact page citations. The support gate, claim–evidence verification, bounded re-retrieval, and abstention above are handbook production extensions based on RAG and agent reliability principles rather than a line-by-line restatement of the tutorial. AI Engineering source.

Related chapters: see Chapter 04 for selective answering and abstention under insufficient evidence, and Chapter 08 for bounded agent loops, stopping conditions, and recovery boundaries. Ch.04 · Ch.08
